A.1 with its exact hypotheses and complete source proof route, or a specific missing-work record for each. The following reported claims appear only as 'not proved in this section', with no proof and no missing-work record: decidability of abelian groups and undecidability of groups; completeness of ACF_p and decidability of ACF_0 and of the complex field; undecidability of Z by Goedel (printed p.16; w02-p02-005.tex:470-484). Definability of N and finite sequences in HF(M) and admissibility of HF(M) (p.43; 1204-1213). Completeness of countable L_omega1omega theories needing an infinitary rule; weak second-order logic translating into L_omega1omega but not conversely; failure of Beth for weak second-order logic; L(Q_0) essentially equivalent to omega-logic (p.44; 1288-1298). Keisler's Completeness and Compactness Theorems for L(Q) (pp.44-45; 1299-1316).
